remarks: Excellent opportunity for buyers looking to add their own personal touch! This duplex-style residence is one side of a 4-unit complex offering low HOA, generous living space, abundant natural light, and strong long-term upside potential. A great opportunity to personalize, renovate over time, and build equity in a highly desirable South Norwalk location. Conveniently located near the South Norwalk train station, major highways, waterfront attractions, restaurants, shopping, and nightlife. Enjoy close proximity to the vibrant SoNo district, known for its popular dining scene, walkable downtown, The SoNo Collection, Maritime Aquarium at Norwalk, and waterfront entertainment. Whether you're looking for your next home or a property with long-term potential, this home offers exceptional opportunity in a prime location. Property being sold as-is.
